register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Learn Mandarin at your own pace. No streaks, no pressure.
register.trial: You start with a {days}-day free trial.
register.password_hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence you can remember works well.
register.invite_hint: Your teacher or school gave you this code.
register.terms_note: By creating an account you agree to:
register.closed_body: We are not taking new accounts at the moment. Please ask your teacher or come back later.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If we have an account for it, we will send a link to choose a new password. The link works for {minutes} minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalid_body: It may have expired or already been used. You can ask for a new one.

err.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
err.email_taken: This email already has an account. Try logging in instead.
err.password_short: Your password needs at least {min} characters.
err.password_long: That password is too long. Please use at most {max_password} characters.
err.password_same_as_email: Your password must not be the same as your email.
err.password_common: That password is very common and easy to guess. Please choose another one.
err.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
err.invite_invalid: That invite code is not right.
err.login_failed: The email or password is not correct.

flash.logged_out: You are logged out. See you soon.
flash.reset_sent: If that email has an account, we have sent a link. Please check your inbox and spam folder.
flash.password_reset: Your password is changed. Please log in with the new one.
flash.welcome: Welcome! Let's set up your learning.

mail.reset_body:
Hello,

Someone (hopefully you) asked to choose a new password for your Huayu Coach account. Open this link to do it:

{link}

The link works for {minutes} minutes and can be used once. If this was not you, just ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

Huayu Coach
